+"""Split assertion explanations without importing pytest."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_explanation_split", "vendored_explanation_split_variant"]
+
+
+def vendored_explanation_split(explanation: str) -> list[str]:
+    r"""Return a list of individual lines in the explanation.
+
+    This will return a list of lines split on '\n{', '\n}' and '\n~'.
+    Any other newlines will be escaped and appear in the line as the
+    literal '\n' characters.
+    """
+    raw_lines = (explanation or "").split("\n")
+    lines = [raw_lines[0]]
+    for values in raw_lines[1:]:
+        if values and values[0] in ["{", "}", "~", ">"]:
+            lines.append(values)
+        else:
+            lines[-1] += "\\n" + values
+    return lines
+
+
+def vendored_explanation_split_variant(explanation: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Return the split explanation lines as a tuple."""
+    return tuple(vendored_explanation_split(explanation))

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType
+from typing import ClassVar
+import unittest
+
+
+class TestStandaloneExplanationSplit(unittest.TestCase):
+    module: ClassVar[ModuleType]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
+        path = (
+            Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+            / "src"
+            / "standalone_wave6_explanation_split.py"
+        )
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("offline_explanation_split", path)
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        cls.module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        spec.loader.exec_module(cls.module)
+
+    def test_control_markers_and_escaped_newlines(self) -> None:
+        explanation = "assert x\ncontinued\n{where x\n}suffix\n~diff\n>note\n"
+        lines = [r"assert x\ncontinued", "{where x", "}suffix", "~diff", r">note\n"]
+        self.assertEqual(self.module.vendored_explanation_split(explanation), lines)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self.module.vendored_explanation_split_variant(explanation), tuple(lines)
+        )
+
+    def test_empty_explanations(self) -> None:
+        for value in ("", None):
+            with self.subTest(value=value):
+                self.assertEqual(self.module.vendored_explanation_split(value), [""])
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    self.module.vendored_explanation_split_variant(value), ("",)
+                )
+
+    def test_non_string_input_raises(self) -> None:
+        for split in (
+            self.module.vendored_explanation_split,
+            self.module.vendored_explanation_split_variant,
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(split=split.__name__), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
+                split(b"not a string")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
